stop_rules.semantic_or_methodological_failure: close the current bounded phase and design the next P012 successor step from aggregate attribution; do not hot-fix consumed evidence
stop_rules.technical_failure: diagnose first; retry only when a separately frozen technical-recovery contract preserves semantic identity
stop_rules.external_authority_or_tool_blocker: stop at the durable checkpoint and report the exact blocker rather than bypassing the boundary

claim_ceiling: This delegation removes repeated owner-approval handoffs inside P3-STAGE-012. It does not waive any frozen evidence, freshness, partition, runtime, strategy or trading gate.
